items.title: Complete source-defined worker05 formulation curation before final shard acceptance
items.body:
Worker05's published source-review head `b44430c9230e62f9d9d73154484311b77442e73e` declares the shard complete, but at least one no-change disposition defers curation that the campaign already authorizes rather than documenting an unavailable scientific prerequisite.

Affected case: `KG_CASE:b58f2778ba8c8905faf5cddf634ff4d5059978baa1b2489af2eb4db7f7e9fef1`, MediaDive ingredient1382, Grace's Insect Medium. Existing source owner: `data/ingredients/unmapped/Graces_Insect_Medium.yaml`, SHA256 `98d818debe40f93d28b7c08b2a7437b6a3c8566e12c857aa7f42fd3c1cdafa3e`.

The [committed decision](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/b44430c9230e62f9d9d73154484311b77442e73e/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-05/media/decisions.json) explicitly binds the source to Sigma G8142 and cites the manufacturer's complete formula. Its no-change and missing-requirement fields say to curate that formula and review component identities. There is no proposal, and no distinct missing evidence for the whole supplied product is identified.

The [manufacturer formula](https://www.sigmaaldrich.cn/deepweb/assets/sigmaaldrich/product/documents/172/423/g8142for.pdf) distinguishes G8142 liquid1x from G9771 powder, including bicarbonate treatment. Worker evidence `MEDIA-SIGMA-G8142-FORMULA` retains the PDF at SHA256 `7a07a208abd686522d82c3d61bc682af4e377ebd226bdbe786c2f9e84727b140`. This is a lead for supplied-product curation, not approval of any generic medium equivalence or every component identity.

MAPPING_SEMANTICS sections3 and6 and the add-media workflow distinguish whole preparation identity from component grounding. Named ungrounded parts may remain explicit; a missing component CURIE is not by itself proof that an evidence-defined preparation must stay entirely uncurated. The campaign requires justified curation, not only a list of future curation tasks.

Please reassess this case and the other worker05 no-change dispositions whose stated blocker is simply to curate, define or reconcile an already identified formulation. For each, either prepare a concrete evidence-backed proposal through the existing proposal workflow, or record the exact unresolved scientific fact and the primary-source searches actually attempted. Preserve historical/source scope, competing-owner boundaries, raw labels, prior holds, and separate full-payload/release review. Do not invent a catalog variant, infer a complete formula from a source name, merge owners, treat all product names as resolved, or approve roles.

For G8142 specifically, verify the source-to-product attribution and all current owner occurrences before choosing whether the existing owner can be specialized or a separate source-qualified preparation is needed. Transcribe only supported formulation claims; preserve any uncertainty in individual component form or quantity explicitly. Independent re-review must cover the revised disposition/proposal and final head.

Deduplication: the complete652-visible-issue all-state snapshot and relevant Grace/G8142/worker05 title/body matches contained no exact completeness finding. #1176 and #1177 cover separate peptone/Sea Salts defects. This issue does not reopen those or supersede a scientific hold.
